q1_what_did_you_play: I played Fwoosh! at Seapunk, then Bang Bang!, then Kaboom! at Seapunk, then Duck and Cover. This spends all 3 Spark and 2 of 3 Energy, dealing 25 total damage and gaining 5 Block.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Firework Finale, Kaboom!, and Duck and Cover. That line also deals 25 damage and gains 5 Block, but it Exhausts Firework Finale and concentrates the 18 damage in one hit instead of using Fwoosh! and Bang Bang!.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up the single 18-damage hit from Firework Finale and the chance to Exhaust it. With only one enemy and no known benefit to Exhaust from the printed information, that trade was not worth sacrificing the equivalent damage from Fwoosh! and Bang Bang!.
q4_different_intent: No. The enemy's telegraphed Attack for 11 makes Duck and Cover useful, but even if the intent were different, there is no better affordable damage line and no alternative use for the remaining Energy that would change the play.
